LeTR14h is the best model for 2025 Ioniq 5. It stayed in lane at all speeds while it is mostly smooth.
* TR14 and TR15 handled low speed torque smoothness better but were unstable at high speeds.
* LeTR14h only sometimes approaches the left line an uncomfortable amount but this is better than all past models.
* Overall this model handled straight sections of road/highway better than any previous model so I love it!

(This doesn't work with hkg-angle branch yet. I had to make my own branch adding refactor modeld to hkg-angle.)

* 100% min active torque
* Live Delay disabled, software delay 0.21
* HKG angle smoothing disabled

I'm using LeTR14h on my 2025 Ioniq 5 because nothing else is able to keep it in lane. This model also kind of works on my Toyota. But I noticed it occasionally fails hard on both cars in the same way. The vision sometimes gets confused about seeing the line and it crosses the left line. TR7 seemed to be significantly more reliable at seeing the lane lines by comparison.
Interesting I wonder why your car is reacting that way
Almost every new model has held the car centered in lane for me

every car behaves differently for models
your car might have very good controls

But the problem I'm complaining about here is actually all TR models since TR10 seem to get confused about seeing lines during certain lighting conditions. I did a ton of driving with TR7 and never seen it fail like this. It's fine if it sees lines.
TR7 was hot garbage on no line neighborhood roads with lots of parked cars, which i mainly drive
yes I experienced exactly that! (with no lines it is quite bad)

After testing all the recent TR models on both cars I'm sticking to these for now:
* Toyota: Nothing comes close to the precision of TR7 lat. Long isn't great though.
* 2025 Ioniq 5: LeTR14h is the best at staying in lane. Nothing else stays in lane. It doesn't feel great but it's the only thing without left hug. Unfortunately it gets confused about lines and crosses the left line on rare occasions.
